evals.prompt: Use @ws-spec-to-issue to turn this idea into a tracker item: "let users tag invoices with a cost center and filter reports by it". Do not touch the working tree.
evals.expected_output: Agent reformulates the idea into a spec-shaped payload, anonymizes it, resolves the active tracker, runs validate-auth, and creates the item via the provider create-issue intent (or prints a --dry-run payload). No local spec file is written.
assertions: Payload is reformulated (Description + testable ACs + Out of Scope), not a verbatim copy of the input
Agent resolves the tracker from .ws/config.json and loads only the resolved provider body
Agent runs the provider validate-auth before any mutating call
No {specsDir} / {plansDir} artifact is created and no git mutation occurs

evals.prompt: /spec-to-issue --dry-run "add a retry to the webhook dispatcher"
evals.expected_output: Agent prints the resolved tracker, title, and anonymized body and creates nothing.
assertions: Prints the resolved tracker, title, and reformulated body
Does not call the provider create-issue mutation path
